# Md. Mobin Chowdhury

> Undergraduate physics student at the University of Dhaka and aspiring AI researcher working on deep learning, quantum computing, and large language models.

Personal academic portfolio: research publications, projects, articles, courses, and code snippets.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mobinc.vercel.app/): About, education, experience, skills, publications, and projects
- [Articles](https://mobinc.vercel.app/articles): Blog posts on AI, deep learning, and software engineering
- [Projects](https://mobinc.vercel.app/projects): Selected software and research projects
- [Publications](https://mobinc.vercel.app/#publications): Peer-reviewed papers on super-resolution, radio galaxy classification, and test-time adaptation
- [Courses](https://mobinc.vercel.app/courses): Courses instructed as a research/teaching assistant
- [Snippets](https://mobinc.vercel.app/snippets): Reusable code snippets
- [Resources](https://mobinc.vercel.app/resources): Curated learning resources
- [Events](https://mobinc.vercel.app/events): Talks, achievements, and activities

## Articles

- [React Native vs Flutter: Which to Choose in 2026](https://mobinc.vercel.app/articles/react-native-vs-flutter): Compare architectures, performance, and business trade-offs between the two cross-platform frameworks.
- [Deep Dive in Attention Mechanism: The Backbone of Modern NLP](https://mobinc.vercel.app/articles/deep-dive-in-attention-mechanism): History, intuition, mathematics, and implementation of the attention algorithms powering modern NLP.
- [Job and AI: My Thoughts](https://mobinc.vercel.app/articles/my-thoughts-on-job-and-ai): How AI is transforming the job market for developers, with an optimistic outlook on future work.
- [Diving into Group Theory: Foundations for Equivariant Neural Networks](https://mobinc.vercel.app/articles/group-theory-foundations-equivariant-neural-networks): Group properties, generators, and subgroups bridging mathematics with equivariant neural network design.
